column1: # Shared package manifest for tools/bootstrap-linux.sh and tools/bootstrap-mac.sh.
#   apt / brew value: a package name | installer:<id> (no package; the script runs a named installer)
#                     | builtin (the OS ships it) | none (deliberate gap on that platform)
#   tiers: core, dev, search (apt installs these best-effort), cask (brew --cask; macOS only)
# Project-specific tooling (ML libraries, game engines, LaTeX) is intentionally absent.
